traits.name: Impaling Critical
traits.text: When a titan centipede scores a critical hit with its mandibles, the target is painfully pierced with barbed spines and bristles, taking 1d6 (1d6) persistent bleed damage and becoming flat-footed as long as the bleed damage continues.

traits.name: Titan Centipede Venom
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 28 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 2d6 (2d6) poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 round) Stage 2 2d8 (2d8) poison damage, clumsy 2, and slowed 1 (1 round) Stage 3 2d10 (2d10) poison damage, clumsy 2, and slowed 2 (1 round)

traits.name: Undulate
traits.text: ⬻ The titan centipede Strides up to its Speed or Steps. During this movement, it can pass through spaces as narrow as 10 feet without Squeezing.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ mandibles +21 (reach 20 feet); Damage 2d10+12 (2d10+12) piercing plus titan centipede venom
